`dependency_kinds` type exhaustivement chaque prérequis, par exemple
`{"L-0":{"kind":"EXECUTION","expected":"campagne après code, NOT RUN","evidence":[]}}`.
kind vaut DOCUMENT, CODE ou EXECUTION. En readiness documentaire, une preuve
future peut rester NOT RUN : `expected` décrit alors le résultat attendu et
evidence reste vide. Au préflight seulement, DOCUMENT exige le contrat/proof
disponible, CODE exige evidence et `outputs:[file_ref,...]` décrivant l'output
ou API disponible, EXECUTION exige evidence et lot fournisseur completed avec
preuve de completion. DOCUMENT/CODE n'exigent pas que tout le fournisseur
soit completed. Ne pas inventer une dépendance d'exécution quand une relation
documentaire suffit.

`requires_details:[element/question ID,...]` est optionnel. Un détail
réversible ouvert ne bloque pas globalement DESIGN ou PLANS READY. Il bloque
uniquement le préflight du lot qui l'exige explicitement ; le reviewer confirme que la
dépendance n'a pas été omise. `status` est `planned` par défaut ou `completed` ;
un lot completed exige `completion_evidence:[file_ref,...]` non vide.
Avant un lot, ses prérequis doivent être disponibles selon leur type.
Les tâches rejected/superseded historiques gardent leurs IDs et références,
sans devoir appartenir à un lot courant ; leur rattachement ou exécution dans
un lot/checkpoint courant est interdit.

### Checkpoint et préconditions d'un lot

`checkpoint` contient `phase` (`DESIGN`, `PLANS`, `IMPLEMENTATION`), `next_actor`
(authority ID), `pending_tasks:[task ID,...]`. En HOST_PERSISTED, ajouter
`raw_contributions:[file_ref,...]` trié, avec les références des
`transports/<ID>/transport-manifest.json` des apports bruts nécessaires à la
reprise. `check-state` vérifie chemins, unicité et hashes de cette liste ;
l'hôte revérifie les contenus des TRANSPORT au moyen de son audit. L'absence
de cette liste dans un ancien état ne prouve pas que les contributions ont été
conservées ; le coordinateur ne revendique pas un handoff complet sans elle.
PLANS requiert DESIGN READY ;
IMPLEMENTATION requiert PLANS READY. Le checkpoint n'accorde aucune permission
externe : il rend explicites le prochain acteur et le travail en attente.

Pour `check-state --lot LOT-ID`, la phase doit être IMPLEMENTATION et le lot
doit porter :

```json
{
  "preconditions": {
    "railguard": {
      "activation": "active",
      "ref": {"path":"RAILGUARD.md","sha256":"..."},
      "hashes": [{"path":"baseline.json","sha256":"..."}]
    },
    "authorization": {
      "authority": "USER",
      "source": {"path":"authorization.md","sha256":"..."},
      "lot_id": "LOT-ID",
      "paths": ["src/main.rs"]
    },
    "drift": {
      "classification": "none",
      "previous_lots": [],
      "evidence": [{"path":"preflight.md","sha256":"..."}]
    },
    "repository_evidence": [],
    "code_state": {"baseline":[],"ledger":[],"current":[]}
  }
}
```

Une railguard `active` exige des hashes courants non vides et la référence du
contrat ; `not_applicable` est interdit avant un lot. L'autorisation vient
d'une authority user ou governance/implementer explicitement déléguée,
possède une source et un lot_id exact ; tous les paths du lot doivent être
dans ses paths autorisés. Les préconditions documentées du dépôt peuvent
ajouter des preuves à `repository_evidence:[file_ref,...]`, sans les remplacer
par la simple réussite de ce contrôle documentaire.

`drift.classification` distingue `none` (previous_lots vide) et
`expected_previous_lots` (liste non vide de prérequis). Les preuves décrivent
le drift observé et pourquoi il provient du travail autorisé déjà réalisé.
Le script contrôle ces références et hashes courants ; il ne calcule pas un
diff Git et n'accepte pas automatiquement un drift inconnu. Aucun reset Git.
Les preuves de préflight sont contrôlées au lancement du lot concerné ; elles
ne doivent pas faire passer une baseline ancienne pour la baseline courante.

Les corpus documentaires et snapshots D0 restent figés. L'évolution autorisée
du code après chaque lot ne requiert pas une nouvelle revue du design figé :
elle est contrôlée séparément par `preconditions.code_state` :

```json
{
  "baseline": [{"path":"src/main.rs","sha256":"...",
    "snapshot":{"path":"snapshots/D0/main.rs","sha256":"..."},
    "revision":"révision Git ou identité explicite de D0","dirty_hash":"..."}],
  "ledger": [{"path":"src/main.rs","sha256":"...","lot_id":"L-0",
    "evidence":[{"path":"completed/L-0.md","sha256":"..."}]}],
  "current": [{"path":"src/main.rs","sha256":"..."}]
}
```

Chaque baseline désigne son chemin original, sa révision et le hash de l'état
dirty documenté ; le hash de contenu doit égaler celui du snapshot immuable,
lui-même inclus dans le manifest DESIGN. Le script ne calcule pas l'identité
Git : les preuves de dépôt la confirment. Le ledger, dans l'ordre des lots,
porte uniquement les outputs de lots ancêtres completed, chacun dans ses
paths autorisés et avec preuve de sortie. Des outputs successifs sur le même
chemin doivent suivre l'ordre de dépendance des lots. current contient les
fichiers actuels du périmètre audité, triés/uniques, hashes réellement vérifiés.
Son inventaire doit égaler baseline plus nouveaux chemins du ledger ; chaque
hash actuel doit égaler baseline ou le dernier output autorisé du ledger.
Les sources modifiées sont donc comparées à la progression attendue, jamais
présentées comme D0 inchangé. Un drift imprévu suspend le préflight ; aucun
reset automatique. L'exhaustivité du périmètre et la vérité des preuves de
sortie restent à confirmer par le reviewer et les contrôles du dépôt.

Si une **source vivante** est directement incluse dans un manifest et change,
`verify-manifest` échoue. Utiliser les snapshots D0 avec leur provenance pour
la revue initiale et code_state pour le courant. Un snapshot ne prouve jamais
l'état courant du dépôt. Les manifests et preuves documentaires eux-mêmes ne
peuvent diverger silencieusement, même lorsque le code progresse comme prévu.

## Commandes et promotion atomique

`--files-list` est le chemin d'un fichier JSON contenant un tableau de chemins
relatifs, pas une commande shell ni une chaîne de chemins séparés.

```powershell
python scripts/predev_control.py create-manifest --root DOSSIER --scope DESIGN --candidate-id D-1 --files-list design-files.json --output DOSSIER/design.manifest.json
python scripts/predev_control.py create-manifest --root DOSSIER --scope PLANS --candidate-id P-1 --design-candidate-id D-1 --files-list plan-files.json --output DOSSIER/plans.manifest.json
python scripts/predev_control.py verify-manifest --root DOSSIER --manifest DOSSIER/design.manifest.json
python scripts/predev_control.py check-state --root DOSSIER --state DOSSIER/pending.json
python scripts/predev_control.py check-state --root DOSSIER --state DOSSIER/current.json --lot LOT-ID
python scripts/predev_control.py promote-checkpoint --root DOSSIER --pending DOSSIER/pending.json --current DOSSIER/current.json
```

Les chemins des options de fichiers CLI sont des chemins système, résolus
depuis le cwd ; les chemins internes aux JSON restent relatifs à --root.
Les commandes renvoient un petit JSON et exit 0 en réussite ; un diagnostic
sur stderr et exit 1 en cas d'échec du contrôle (argparse utilise exit 2).

`promote-checkpoint` vérifie pending et ses corpus/proofs avant toute mutation,
vérifie que pending n'a pas changé pendant le contrôle, écrit un temporaire
dans le répertoire de current, flush/fsync, puis `os.replace` atomique. Elle
conserve current préexistant si le contrôle échoue. Elle ne réécrit pas pending
et refuse de cibler un fichier de corpus, de manifest ou de preuve. current
et les outputs manifest doivent rester sous root. Elle ne verrouille pas le
dossier : garder corpus et pending stables pendant l'opération ; une mutation
concurrente ultérieure est détectée au contrôle suivant.

Le contrôle ne lance aucun Cargo, aucune commande dépôt, aucun outil natif.
Une qualification d'interface exige toujours une preuve du widget rendu dans
son conteneur réel. Un profil `readOnly` ou un actor distinct n'est pas une
preuve de qualification ou d'indépendance effective.

Les fixtures temporaires et cas positifs/négatifs reproductibles sont dans
`scripts/test_predev_control.py` :

```powershell
python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_predev_control.py -v
```

`test_predev_control.write_positive_fixture(root)` exporte dans un dossier de
test isolé les fichiers, manifests et `state.json` positifs complets. Ces
verdicts et sources sont **synthétiques**, destinés à comprendre et tester le
schéma ; ils ne sont jamais une revue réelle ni une preuve de qualification.
Exemple depuis le répertoire scripts, avec un dossier de test réservé :

```powershell
python -c "from test_predev_control import write_positive_fixture; write_positive_fixture('C:/temp/predev-fixture')"
python predev_control.py check-state --root C:/temp/predev-fixture --state C:/temp/predev-fixture/state.json --lot L-1
```

## HOST_PERSISTED : persistance par l'hôte autorisé

Lorsque l'orchestrateur natif readOnly ne peut pas écrire ses documents,
il produit une proposition JSON attribuée. L'hôte autorisé utilise
`scripts/predev_host.py` pour l'auditer puis la persister dans une racine
documentaire exacte. Cette séparation ne suppose pas qu'un profil readOnly
soit techniquement étanche : elle exige les permissions réellement observées
et conserve les résultats bruts de qualification. Le helper ne lance aucun
sous-processus, réseau, secret, code produit, commande dépôt ou configuration.

Le protocole `rust-predev-host/1` est :

```json
{
  "schema":"rust-predev-host/1",
  "scope":"DESIGN",
  "proposal_id":"PROPOSAL-D1",
  "actor":"ORCHESTRATOR-READONLY",
  "base_candidate_id":null,
  "target_candidate_id":"D-1",
  "pack_digest":"...",
  "files":[{"path":"design.md","content":"texte exact reçu\n","base_sha256":null}]
}
```

scope vaut DESIGN, PLANS ou TRANSPORT. PLANS ajoute `design_candidate_id`
obligatoire ; les autres scopes interdisent ce champ. proposal_id et les IDs
de versions utilisent ASCII lettres/chiffres/tiret/underscore, commencent par
une lettre ou chiffre, et ont au plus 96 caractères ; noms appareils Windows
refusés. Un proposal_id déjà persisté et un target ID déjà existant sont
refusés. Un candidat nouveau ne réutilise jamais l'ID du précédent.

Les files représentent le **corpus complet** de la nouvelle version ; chaque
content est enregistré en UTF-8 sans modification de ses fins de ligne. Les
paths sont locaux à cette version (par exemple `design.md`, pas
`candidates/D-1/design.md`). Slash/NFC, casefold et collisions fichier/dossier
sont contrôlés ; aucune traversée, chemin appareil/glob, source Rust, script,
configuration ou chemin hors allowlist. Extensions documentaires admises :
md/json/txt/csv/tsv. Les noms racine proposal.json/receipt.json/manifest.json/
transport-manifest.json sont réservés aux métadonnées hôte.

L'hôte fournit séparément une policy sourcée :

```json
{
  "schema":"rust-predev-host/1",
  "host_actor":"AUTHORIZED-HOST",
  "proposal_actor":"ORCHESTRATOR-READONLY",
  "roots":["C:/docs/predev-run"],
  "paths":["design.md","pending.json","plans.md","raw-review.json"],
  "source":{"path":"human-authorization.md","sha256":"..."}
}
```

source est une autorisation humaine existante, hashée, sous cette racine ;
elle définit le mandat réel de l'hôte, l'acteur proposant, la racine et les
chemins exacts. Les deux acteurs sont distincts. Ce contrôle de déclaration
sourcée n'authentifie pas une identité à partir de son nom. Le caller autorisé
doit fournir la policy réelle ; l'orchestrateur readOnly ne s'accorde pas le
mandat hôte en fabriquant une policy. La racine doit déjà exister, être dans
l'allowlist absolue et être dédiée aux documents. Dans un dépôt Git, seule la
racine `docs/predev` ou un dossier projet direct `docs/predev/<projet>` est
admise ; la policy doit allowlister cette racine exacte et les chemins de
documents exacts. Aucun lien/junction interne, fichier produit, .git,
Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, .codex, config ou memory ; aucune autre destination à
l'intérieur d'un dépôt Git/Cargo ou des sources skills/agents/plugins/config/
memory n'est acceptée. Un dossier documentaire dédié sous le central `.codex`
est admis : aucun fichier global n'est touché.

`--pack-manifest` est un manifest canonique rust-predev/2 de **freeze du pack**
créé avec `predev_control.create_manifest(PACK_ROOT,"DESIGN","PACK-ID",paths)`.
Le scope DESIGN de ce freeze sert au format de contrôle de fichiers et ne
constitue aucune gate produit. `pack_digest` est son champ digest canonique,
pas le SHA du fichier manifest entier. Tous ses fichiers réels sont
revérifiés ; il doit inclure exactement un predev_host.py et un
predev_control.py dont les octets égalent les helpers exécutés. Le freeze
natifs doit couvrir aussi les profils/skills réellement utilisés.

DESIGN/PLANS utilisent des lignées séparées. La première version d'un scope
porte base_candidate_id null ; la suivante cite la dernière version de ce
même scope. Chaque base est revérifiée sur son corpus réel. base_sha256 doit
égaler le hash brut de chaque fichier existant dans cette base, ou null pour
un fichier nouveau. PLANS cite la dernière version DESIGN : exemple D-1,
puis D-2(base D-1), puis P-1(base null, design_candidate_id D-2). Toute base
périmée, changée, mauvaise portée ou parent périmé est refusé.

Les versions sont publiées sous `root/candidates/ID/`, avec proposal.json,
receipt.json et manifest.json. Le helper appelle le contrôleur pour créer
le manifest au **vrai scope** ; le corpus PLANS inclut automatiquement
`candidates/DESIGN-ID/manifest.json`. Le reçu contient hashes, IDs, génération,
pack digest, source d'autorité, actor proposant et persisted_by hôte. Il ne
contient aucun gate, READY ou verdict : l'hôte ne fabrique pas CLEAN.

TRANSPORT persiste un apport brut de spécialiste, un résultat de revue, un état
ou un verdict réellement fourni dans
`root/transports/ID/`, en citant une base candidate existante et actuelle.
base_sha256 est null. Son transport-manifest.json utilise
`rust-predev-transport/1` et ne constitue pas un manifest DESIGN/PLANS ni une
gate. Ainsi un résultat reviewer conserve son contenu exact **hors du corpus
qu'il a relu**, sans recalculer son verdict ou modifier la source auteur.
L'orchestrateur et l'hôte attachent ensuite le vrai résultat à l'état de gate
par le processus de revue/contrôle prévu ; le reçu transport seul n'est pas
une autorisation de transfert. Les transports déjà persistés sont revérifiés.
Si l'apport est revendiqué comme copie exacte d'une source exportable, comparer
ses octets UTF-8 avant et après persistance, sans normaliser les fins de ligne :

```text
python scripts/verify_raw_handoff.py --source SOURCE.txt --proposal PROPOSITION.json --proposal-file raw.txt
python scripts/verify_raw_handoff.py --source SOURCE.txt --proposal PROPOSITION.json --proposal-file raw.txt --transport ROOT/transports/T-1/raw.txt
```

Le résultat donne le SHA-256 et la taille de la source sans afficher son contenu.
Ce contrôle détecte notamment un LF ajouté ou une conversion CRLF/LF ; il ne
prouve ni l'identité de l'auteur ni que l'export vient du message indiqué.
Le coordinateur et le reviewer vérifient ces points, la base intellectuelle,
les versions/IDs et la base technique du transport séparément.
Pour un apport de spécialiste reçu avant le premier candidat, l'hôte persiste
d'abord un candidat DESIGN DRAFT, puis le TRANSPORT lié à ce candidat. Après
chaque apport, le coordinateur vérifie le reçu et le transport-manifest, ajoute
sa référence dans `checkpoint.raw_contributions`, et ne passe au rôle suivant
qu'après promotion du checkpoint. Le fichier brut conserve acteur/rôle,
base/versions, IDs/owners, sources/statuts, contenu proposé, questions et
travail restant sans reformulation par l'hôte. Une nouvelle version du corpus
n'efface pas les transports historiques ; le checkpoint courant cite ceux qui
restent nécessaires à la provenance et à la reprise.

Audit est une opération sans écriture. Apply refait audit, acquiert un lock
de writer hôte exclusif, revérifie ses entrées, écrit un staging contrôlé sous
root avec flush/fsync, puis refait audit avant un rename atomique de dossier.
Le staging possède un nom UUID créé exclusivement via mkdir(mode=0o777) sous
root, pour hériter de son ACL documentaire autorisée. Il n'utilise pas
tempfile.mkdtemp : sous Windows Python 3.13, le mode 0o700 de cette API crée
une ACL privée qui reste attachée au dossier après son rename et empêche les
rôles sandbox readOnly de lire les documents publiés. Aucun chmod, grant,
icacls ou changement d'ACL globale. Vérification du 2026-10-04 : sources
[os.mkdir Python 3.13](https://docs.python.org/3.13/library/os.html#os.mkdir) et
[tempfile.mkdtemp](https://docs.python.org/3.13/library/tempfile.html#tempfile.mkdtemp),
plus comparaison native ACL root/D1 et refus de lecture réels. Un test Windows
lit les DACL filesystem via ctypes et contrôle les ACE hérités du dossier
publié et de son payload ; la qualification native doit ensuite prouver la
lecture effective depuis les rôles sandbox, sans leur accorder d'écriture.
Toute source/proposal/policy/base/pack changée provoque un refus. Les versions
préexistantes restent inchangées ; staging et lock sont retirés en échec
ordinaire. Un lock existant n'est jamais supprimé automatiquement. Aucun
checkpoint current n'est promu implicitement. Garder le dossier stable contre
d'autres writers externes pendant l'opération ; le lock coordonne ces helpers,
pas tous les processus du système. Après crash dur, qualifier le staging/lock
avant nettoyage manuel. La promotion atomique du dossier est testée sur
Windows ; elle ne promet pas une transaction contre des modifications
concurrentes arbitraires faites hors helper.

```powershell
python -B scripts/predev_host.py audit --root C:/docs/predev-run --proposal C:/docs/predev-run/proposal-input.json --policy C:/docs/predev-run/policy.json --pack-root C:/Users/cyril/.codex --pack-manifest C:/docs/predev-run/pack.manifest.json
python -B scripts/predev_host.py apply --root C:/docs/predev-run --proposal C:/docs/predev-run/proposal-input.json --policy C:/docs/predev-run/policy.json --pack-root C:/Users/cyril/.codex --pack-manifest C:/docs/predev-run/pack.manifest.json
python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_predev_host.py -v
```

Exit 0 renvoie un reçu JSON sans réimprimer les contents ; exit 1 signale un
refus sur stderr, argparse utilise exit 2. L'audit et le reçu de persistance
ne remplacent jamais la revue indépendante ni la qualification native.
Utiliser Python -B aussi pour les runners qui importent ces helpers, afin de
ne pas créer de __pycache__ dans le pack installé. Le helper CLI désactive
également l'écriture des caches de ses imports pour son propre processus.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small, offline document controls for rust-predev/2; Python stdlib only."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import tempfile
import unicodedata

SCHEMA = "rust-predev/2"
HEX = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
NATURES = {"requirement", "decision", "constraint", "exclusion", "invariant",
           "use_case", "acceptance", "structural_assumption", "reversible_detail", "task"}
RUBRICS = {
    "DESIGN": {"scope", "use_cases", "errors", "domain", "dependencies", "persistence",
               "concurrency", "platform", "acceptance", "risks", "railguard"},
    "PLANS": {"coverage", "dependencies", "preflight", "verification", "authorization", "railguard", "handoff"},
}


class ControlError(ValueError):
    pass


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ControlError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                       separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def _pairs(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        require(key not in result, "duplicate JSON key: " + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_json(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes().decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=_pairs,
                          parse_constant=lambda s: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ControlError("invalid JSON number: " + s)))
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ControlError(f"cannot read JSON {path}: {exc}") from exc


def normalized_path(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and value, "file path must be a nonempty string")
    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", value.replace("\\", "/"))
    require(not value.startswith("/") and ":" not in value,
            "absolute or drive-qualified path forbidden: " + value)
    require(all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in value.split("/")),
            "empty, dot or parent path segment forbidden: " + value)
    require(not any(ord(char) < 32 for char in value), "control character in path")
    return value


def resolved_path(root, value):
    rel = normalized_path(value)
    base = Path(root).resolve()
    target = (base / rel).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(base), "path escapes root: " + rel)
    return target


def rooted(root, value):
    target = resolved_path(root, value)
    require(target.is_file(), "file missing: " + value)
    return target


def unique_paths(values, canonical_input=False):
    require(isinstance(values, list), "paths must be a JSON array")
    result, seen = [], set()
    for value in values:
        path = normalized_path(value)
        require(not canonical_input or path == value, "path is not slash/NFC canonical: " + str(value))
        require(path.casefold() not in seen, "duplicate or casefold-colliding path: " + path)
        seen.add(path.casefold())
        result.append(path)
    return sorted(result)


def file_hash(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def payload_digest(payload):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(payload)).hexdigest()


def identifier(value, label):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()), label + " must be a nonempty ID")
    return value


def create_manifest(root, scope, candidate_id, files, design_candidate_id=None):
    require(scope in ("DESIGN", "PLANS"), "invalid manifest scope")
    identifier(candidate_id, "candidate_id")
    require((scope == "PLANS") == (design_candidate_id is not None),
            "only PLANS requires design_candidate_id")
    if design_candidate_id is not None:
        identifier(design_candidate_id, "design_candidate_id")
        require(candidate_id != design_candidate_id, "DESIGN and PLANS candidate IDs must differ")
    paths = unique_paths(files)
    require(paths, "manifest corpus must not be empty")
    payload = {"schema": SCHEMA, "scope": scope, "candidate_id": candidate_id,
               "files": [{"path": path, "sha256": file_hash(rooted(root, path))} for path in paths]}
    if design_candidate_id is not None:
        payload["design_candidate_id"] = design_candidate_id
    return dict(payload, digest=payload_digest(payload))


def verify_manifest(root, manifest, check_corpus=True):
    path = Path(manifest)
    value = read_json(path)
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "manifest must be an object")
    require(path.read_bytes() == canonical(value), "manifest bytes are not canonical UTF-8 JSON with final LF")
    scope = value.get("scope")
    require(scope in ("DESIGN", "PLANS"), "invalid manifest scope")
    expected = {"schema", "scope", "candidate_id", "files", "digest"}
    if scope == "PLANS":
        expected.add("design_candidate_id")
    require(set(value) == expected, "manifest keys or scope/parent mismatch")
    require(value["schema"] == SCHEMA, "unsupported manifest schema")
    identifier(value["candidate_id"], "candidate_id")
    if scope == "PLANS":
        identifier(value["design_candidate_id"], "design_candidate_id")
        require(value["candidate_id"] != value["design_candidate_id"], "candidate IDs must differ")
    require(isinstance(value["files"], list) and value["files"], "manifest corpus must not be empty")
    for entry in value["files"]:
        require(isinstance(entry, dict) and set(entry) == {"path", "sha256"}, "invalid manifest file entry")
        require(isinstance(entry["sha256"], str) and HEX.fullmatch(entry["sha256"]), "invalid SHA256")
    paths = [entry["path"] for entry in value["files"]]
    require(paths == unique_paths(paths, canonical_input=True), "manifest files are not sorted by codepoint")
    digest = value["digest"]
    require(isinstance(digest, str) and HEX.fullmatch(digest), "invalid manifest digest")
    payload = {key: val for key, val in value.items() if key != "digest"}
    require(digest == payload_digest(payload), "manifest payload digest mismatch")
    if check_corpus:
        for entry in value["files"]:
            require(file_hash(rooted(root, entry["path"])) == entry["sha256"],
                    "corpus changed: " + entry["path"])
    return value


def proof(root, value, label):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"path", "sha256"}, label + " must be {path,sha256}")
    path = normalized_path(value["path"])
    require(path == value["path"], label + " path must be canonical")
    require(isinstance(value["sha256"], str) and HEX.fullmatch(value["sha256"]), label + " invalid SHA256")
    require(file_hash(rooted(root, path)) == value["sha256"], label + " missing or stale proof: " + path)


def proofs(root, values, label, nonempty=False):
    require(isinstance(values, list) and (values or not nonempty), label + " must be an array" + (" with evidence" if nonempty else ""))
    for value in values:
        proof(root, value, label)


def index(values, label, all_ids):
    require(isinstance(values, list), label + " must be an array")
    result = {}
    for value in values:
        require(isinstance(value, dict), label + " entry must be an object")
        key = identifier(value.get("id"), label + ".id")
        require(key not in all_ids, "duplicate ID: " + key)
        all_ids.add(key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def refs(values, known, label):
    require(isinstance(values, list), label + " must be an ID array")
    require(all(isinstance(value, str) for value in values), label + " must contain strings")
    require(len(values) == len(set(values)), label + " contains duplicates")
    for value in values:
        require(isinstance(value, str) and value in known, label + " unknown reference: " + str(value))


def check_state(root, state, lot_id=None):
    """Validate references/integrity and declared gates; never infer human truth."""
    s = read_json(state) if not isinstance(state, dict) else state
    require(isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "unsupported state schema")
    require(isinstance(s.get("perimeter"), dict), "perimeter missing")
    version = s["perimeter"].get("version")
    require(type(version) is int and version > 0, "perimeter.version must be positive integer")
    all_ids = set()
    authorities = index(s.get("authorities"), "authorities", all_ids)
    elements = index(s.get("elements"), "elements", all_ids)
    questions = index(s.get("questions"), "questions", all_ids)
    findings = index(s.get("findings"), "findings", all_ids)
    gates = index(s.get("gates"), "gates", all_ids)
    lots = index(s.get("lots"), "lots", all_ids)
    candidates = s.get("candidates")
    require(isinstance(candidates, dict) and "DESIGN" in candidates and set(candidates) <= {"DESIGN", "PLANS"}, "candidates must contain DESIGN and optional PLANS")
    manifests, review_indexes, rubric_indexes, observed_drift = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for scope, candidate in candidates.items():
        require(isinstance(candidate, dict), "candidate must be object")
        key = identifier(candidate.get("id"), scope + ".id")
        require(key not in all_ids, "duplicate ID: " + key)
        all_ids.add(key)
        require(candidate.get("status") in ("DRAFT", "READY", "BLOCKED", "STALE"), "invalid candidate status")
        require(candidate.get("perimeter_version") == version, "candidate perimeter version mismatch")
        require(candidate.get("author") in authorities, "candidate author authority missing")
        refs(candidate.get("contributors"), authorities, "candidate.contributors")
        require(candidate["author"] in candidate["contributors"], "contributors must include author and all correctors")
        manifest_path = normalized_path(candidate.get("manifest"))
        require(manifest_path == candidate["manifest"], "candidate manifest path not canonical")
        m = verify_manifest(root, rooted(root, manifest_path), check_corpus=candidate["status"] != "STALE")
        if candidate["status"] == "STALE":
            stale = candidate.get("staleness")
            require(isinstance(stale, dict), "STALE requires staleness declaration")
            identifier(stale.get("reason"), "staleness.reason")
            proofs(root, stale.get("evidence"), "staleness.evidence", nonempty=True)
            observed_drift[scope] = [entry["path"] for entry in m["files"]
                                     if not resolved_path(root, entry["path"]).is_file()
                                     or file_hash(rooted(root, entry["path"])) != entry["sha256"]]
        require(m["scope"] == scope and m["candidate_id"] == key, "candidate manifest scope/ID mismatch")
        if scope == "PLANS":
            parent = candidates["DESIGN"].get("id")
            require(candidate.get("design_candidate_id") == parent == m.get("design_candidate_id"), "PLANS parent DESIGN mismatch")
        else:
            require("design_candidate_id" not in candidate, "DESIGN candidate cannot have parent")
        manifests[scope] = m
    if "PLANS" in candidates:
        parent_path = candidates["DESIGN"]["manifest"]
        require(any(entry["path"] == parent_path for entry in manifests["PLANS"]["files"]),
                "PLANS corpus must include parent DESIGN manifest")
    for scope, candidate in candidates.items():
        review_indexes[scope] = index(candidate.get("reviews"), "candidate.reviews", all_ids)
    for key, gate in gates.items():
        rubric_indexes[key] = index(gate.get("rubrics"), "gate.rubrics", all_ids)
    for auth in authorities.values():
        require(auth.get("role") in ("user", "product", "technical", "governance", "author", "reviewer", "implementer", "coordinator"), "invalid authority role")
        identifier(auth.get("actor"), "authority.actor")
        proofs(root, auth.get("sources"), "authority.sources", nonempty=True)
        refs(auth.get("independent_from", []), authorities, "authority.independent_from")
        if auth.get("independent_from"):
            proof(root, auth.get("independence_source"), "authority.independence_source")
        if auth["role"] in ("product", "technical", "governance", "implementer"):
            require(authorities.get(auth.get("delegated_by"), {}).get("role") == "user", "delegated authority requires user delegated_by")
            proof(root, auth.get("delegation_source"), "authority.delegation_source")
            scope = auth.get("scope")
            require(isinstance(scope, dict) and scope.get("version") == version, "delegated authority scope version mismatch")
            refs(scope.get("natures", []), NATURES, "authority.scope.natures")
            if auth["role"] in ("governance", "implementer"):
                require(scope.get("paths", []) == unique_paths(scope.get("paths", []), canonical_input=True), "authority.scope.paths must be canonical/sorted")
                refs(scope.get("lot_ids", []), lots, "authority.scope.lot_ids")
    def can_approve(authority_id, nature):
        authority = authorities.get(authority_id, {})
        role = authority.get("role")
        if role == "user":
            return True
        if nature in ("requirement", "use_case", "acceptance", "exclusion", "structural_assumption") and role != "product":
            return False
        return role in ("product", "technical", "governance") and nature in authority.get("scope", {}).get("natures", [])
    for element in elements.values():
        nature = element.get("nature")
        require(nature in NATURES, "invalid element nature")
        require(element.get("approval") in ("proposed", "accepted", "validated", "rejected", "superseded"), "invalid element approval")
        require(element["approval"] != "validated" or nature == "structural_assumption", "validated is only for structural assumptions")
        require(element.get("owner") in authorities, "element owner authority missing")
        require(type(element.get("version")) is int and 0 < element["version"] <= version, "invalid element version")
        require(element["approval"] in ("rejected", "superseded") or element["version"] == version, "stale element version: " + element["id"])
        refs(element.get("refs"), all_ids, "element.refs")
        refs(element.get("replaces", []), elements, "element.replaces")
        refs(element.get("acceptance_ids", []), elements, "element.acceptance_ids")
        require(element["id"] not in element.get("replaces", []), "element cannot replace itself")
        if nature == "decision":
            require(not any(elements[key]["nature"] == "invariant" for key in element.get("replaces", [])), "decision cannot override invariant")
        if "source_authority" in element:
            require(element["source_authority"] in authorities, "element source_authority unknown")
        if nature == "invariant":
            require(can_approve(element.get("source_authority"), nature), "invariant requires sourced framing authority")
            require(authorities[element["source_authority"]]["role"] in ("user", "governance", "product"), "invariant framing must derive from user")
        proofs(root, element.get("evidence", []), "element.evidence")
        if element["approval"] in ("accepted", "validated"):
            require(can_approve(element.get("approval_by"), nature), "element approval_by lacks scoped authority")
        if nature == "structural_assumption" and element["approval"] == "validated":
            proofs(root, element.get("evidence"), "structural assumption validation", nonempty=True)
    for question in questions.values():
        require(question.get("classification") in ("blocking", "structural", "reversible_detail"), "invalid question classification")
        require(question.get("status") in ("open", "answered"), "invalid question status")
        require(question.get("owner") in authorities, "question owner authority missing")
        identifier(question.get("deadline"), "question.deadline")
        refs(question.get("impacted_lots"), lots, "question.impacted_lots")
        refs(question.get("refs"), all_ids, "question.refs")
        proofs(root, question.get("evidence", []), "question.evidence", nonempty=question["status"] == "answered")
    for finding in findings.values():
        scope = finding.get("scope")
        require(scope in candidates and finding.get("candidate_id") == candidates[scope]["id"], "finding candidate/scope mismatch")
        if scope == "PLANS":
            require(finding.get("design_candidate_id") == candidates[scope]["design_candidate_id"], "finding parent DESIGN mismatch")
        else:
            require("design_candidate_id" not in finding, "DESIGN finding cannot carry PLANS parent")
        require(finding.get("kind") in ("required", "suggestion"), "invalid finding kind")
        require(finding.get("severity") in ("Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low"), "finding severity missing/invalid")
        require(finding.get("disposition", "ACTION_REQUIRED") in ("ACTION_REQUIRED", "DISPUTED", "RISK_ACCEPTED"), "invalid finding disposition")
        require(finding.get("status") in ("open", "closed"), "invalid finding status")
        require(finding.get("author") == candidates[scope]["author"], "finding author mismatch")
        require(authorities.get(finding.get("reviewer"), {}).get("role") == "reviewer", "finding reviewer authority missing")
        require(finding["reviewer"] not in candidates[scope]["contributors"], "finding reviewer cannot be a contributor")
        require(set(candidates[scope]["contributors"]) <= set(authorities[finding["reviewer"]].get("independent_from", [])), "finding reviewer lacks independence from contributors")
        refs(finding.get("refs"), all_ids, "finding.refs")
        if finding["status"] == "closed":
            closer = authorities.get(finding.get("closed_by"), {})
            require(closer.get("role") == "reviewer" and finding["closed_by"] not in candidates[scope]["contributors"]
                    and set(candidates[scope]["contributors"]) <= set(closer.get("independent_from", [])), "finding closure must be confirmed by an independent reviewer")
            if finding["closed_by"] != finding["reviewer"]:
                proof(root, finding.get("replacement_source"), "finding.replacement_source")
            proofs(root, finding.get("closure_evidence"), "finding.closure_evidence", nonempty=True)
            if finding.get("disposition") == "RISK_ACCEPTED":
                require(finding.get("risk_nature") in NATURES and can_approve(finding.get("confirmed_by"), finding["risk_nature"]), "risk acceptance requires competent scoped authority")
                require(not any(elements[key]["nature"] == "invariant" for key in finding["refs"] if key in elements), "risk acceptance cannot override invariant")
                proof(root, finding.get("confirmation_source"), "finding.confirmation_source")
    for gate in gates.values():
        require(gate.get("scope") in candidates, "gate scope missing")
        rubrics = rubric_indexes[gate["id"]]
        require(rubrics, "gate requires rubrics")
        for rubric in rubrics.values():
            require(rubric.get("key") in RUBRICS[gate["scope"]], "unknown canonical rubric key")
            require(rubric.get("applicability") in ("applicable", "not_applicable"), "invalid rubric applicability")
            require(rubric.get("status") in ("PASS", "GAP"), "invalid rubric status")
            proofs(root, rubric.get("evidence"), "rubric.evidence", nonempty=True)
            if rubric["applicability"] == "not_applicable":
                identifier(rubric.get("reason"), "not_applicable.reason")
                require(rubric["key"] not in ("scope", "railguard"), "scope/railguard rubrics must always apply")
                require(gate["scope"] != "PLANS", "all PLANS rubrics must apply")
    for lot in lots.values():
        require(lot.get("status", "planned") in ("planned", "completed"), "invalid lot status")
        if lot.get("status") == "completed":
            proofs(root, lot.get("completion_evidence"), "lot.completion_evidence", nonempty=True)
        for field in ("needs", "covers", "verifies"):
            refs(lot.get(field), elements, "lot." + field)
        refs(lot.get("prerequisites"), lots, "lot.prerequisites")
        kinds = lot.get("dependency_kinds", {})
        require(isinstance(kinds, dict) and set(kinds) == set(lot["prerequisites"]), "dependency_kinds must map every prerequisite")
        for dependency in kinds.values():
            require(isinstance(dependency, dict) and dependency.get("kind") in ("DOCUMENT", "CODE", "EXECUTION"), "invalid dependency kind")
            proofs(root, dependency.get("evidence", []), "dependency evidence")
            if not dependency.get("evidence"):
                identifier(dependency.get("expected"), "planned dependency.expected")
            if dependency["kind"] == "CODE":
                proofs(root, dependency.get("outputs", []), "CODE dependency outputs/API")
        refs(lot.get("tasks"), elements, "lot.tasks")
        refs(lot.get("requires_details", []), set(elements) | set(questions), "lot.requires_details")
        require(lot.get("paths") == unique_paths(lot.get("paths"), canonical_input=True), "lot paths must be canonical/sorted")
        for task in lot["tasks"]:
            require(elements[task]["nature"] == "task", "lot.tasks must reference tasks")
            require(elements[task]["approval"] not in ("rejected", "superseded") and elements[task]["version"] == version, "lot.tasks cannot execute historical task")
        for need in lot["needs"]:
            require(elements[need]["nature"] in ("requirement", "decision", "constraint", "invariant", "use_case", "acceptance", "structural_assumption") and elements[need]["approval"] in ("accepted", "validated"), "lot need must be accepted/validated")
        for covered in lot["covers"]:
            require(elements[covered]["nature"] == "requirement" and elements[covered]["approval"] == "accepted", "covers must reference accepted requirements")
        for verified in lot["verifies"]:
            element = elements[verified]
            require(element["approval"] == "accepted" and element["nature"] in ("requirement", "acceptance"), "verifies must reference accepted AC or mapped REQ")
            if element["nature"] == "requirement":
                require(element.get("acceptance_ids"), "verified REQ requires explicit acceptance_ids")
        for element in elements.values():
            for ac in element.get("acceptance_ids", []):
                require(elements[ac]["nature"] == "acceptance" and elements[ac]["approval"] == "accepted", "acceptance_ids must map accepted AC")
    visiting, visited = set(), set()
    def visit(key):
        require(key not in visiting, "lot dependency cycle at " + key)
        if key in visited:
            return
        visiting.add(key)
        for dependency in lots[key]["prerequisites"]:
            visit(dependency)
        visiting.remove(key)
        visited.add(key)
    for key in lots:
        visit(key)
    for scope, candidate in candidates.items():
        records = review_indexes[scope]
        for review in records.values():
            require(review.get("scope") == scope and review.get("candidate_id") == candidate["id"], "review scope/candidate mismatch")
            if scope == "PLANS":
                require(review.get("design_candidate_id") == candidate["design_candidate_id"], "review parent DESIGN mismatch")
            else:
                require("design_candidate_id" not in review, "DESIGN review has PLANS parent")
            require(review.get("verdict") in ("CLEAN", "FINDINGS"), "review verdict invalid")
            reviewer = authorities.get(review.get("reviewer"), {})
            require(reviewer.get("role") == "reviewer" and review.get("reviewer") != candidate["author"], "reviewer must be a different reviewer authority")
            require(review["reviewer"] not in candidate["contributors"], "reviewer cannot be a contributor")
            require(set(candidate["contributors"]) <= set(reviewer.get("independent_from", [])), "reviewer requires sourced independence from contributors")
            require(review.get("manifest_digest") == manifests[scope]["digest"], "stale review manifest digest")
            proofs(root, review.get("evidence"), "review.evidence", nonempty=True)
        if candidate["status"] == "READY":
            require(records and all(r["verdict"] == "CLEAN" for r in records.values()), scope + " READY requires current CLEAN reviews")
            require(any(g["scope"] == scope for g in gates.values()), scope + " READY requires a gate")
            keys = [r["key"] for g in gates.values() if g["scope"] == scope for r in g["rubrics"]]
            require(len(keys) == len(set(keys)) and set(keys) == RUBRICS[scope], scope + " READY requires exact canonical rubric inventory")
            require(all(r["status"] == "PASS" for g in gates.values() if g["scope"] == scope for r in g["rubrics"]), scope + " READY gate contains GAP")
            require(not any(f["scope"] == scope and f["kind"] == "required" and f["status"] != "closed" for f in findings.values()), scope + " READY has open required finding")
    if candidates["DESIGN"]["status"] == "READY":
        require(not any(e["nature"] == "structural_assumption" and e["approval"] not in ("validated", "rejected", "superseded") for e in elements.values()), "DESIGN READY has unvalidated structural assumption")
        require(not any(q["status"] == "open" and q["classification"] in ("blocking", "structural") for q in questions.values()), "DESIGN READY has blocking/structural question")
    if "PLANS" in candidates and candidates["PLANS"]["status"] == "READY":
        require(candidates["DESIGN"]["status"] == "READY", "PLANS READY requires DESIGN READY")
        for element in elements.values():
            if element["nature"] == "requirement" and element["approval"] == "accepted":
                require(any(element["id"] in lot["covers"] for lot in lots.values()), "accepted requirement uncovered: " + element["id"])
                verified = any(element["id"] in lot["verifies"] or any(
                    elements[ac]["nature"] == "acceptance" and element["id"] in elements[ac]["refs"]
                    for ac in lot["verifies"]) for lot in lots.values())
                require(verified, "accepted requirement without verification: " + element["id"])
            if element["nature"] == "task" and element["approval"] not in ("rejected", "superseded"):
                owners = [lot for lot in lots.values() if element["id"] in lot["tasks"]]
                require(len(owners) == 1, "task must belong to one lot: " + element["id"])
                lot = owners[0]
                need_link = bool(set(element["refs"]) & set(lot["needs"]))
                prior_link = bool(set(element["refs"]) & set(lot["prerequisites"])) and bool(element.get("justification", "").strip())
                require(need_link or prior_link, "task without need or justified prerequisite: " + element["id"])
    checkpoint = s.get("checkpoint")
    require(isinstance(checkpoint, dict), "checkpoint missing")
    require(checkpoint.get("phase") in ("DESIGN", "PLANS", "IMPLEMENTATION"), "invalid checkpoint phase")
    require(checkpoint.get("next_actor") in authorities, "checkpoint next_actor authority missing")
    refs(checkpoint.get("pending_tasks"), elements, "checkpoint.pending_tasks")
    require(all(elements[key]["nature"] == "task" for key in checkpoint["pending_tasks"]), "checkpoint pending_tasks must be tasks")
    require(all(elements[key]["approval"] not in ("rejected", "superseded") and elements[key]["version"] == version for key in checkpoint["pending_tasks"]), "checkpoint cannot execute historical task")
    if "raw_contributions" in checkpoint:
        proofs(root, checkpoint["raw_contributions"], "checkpoint.raw_contributions")
        paths = [entry["path"] for entry in checkpoint["raw_contributions"]]
        require(paths == unique_paths(paths, canonical_input=True), "checkpoint.raw_contributions must be unique and sorted")
        require(all(re.fullmatch(r"transports/[^/]+/transport-manifest\.json", path) for path in paths),
                "checkpoint.raw_contributions must cite transport manifests")
    if checkpoint["phase"] in ("PLANS", "IMPLEMENTATION"):
        require(candidates["DESIGN"]["status"] == "READY", "checkpoint phase requires DESIGN READY")
    if checkpoint["phase"] == "IMPLEMENTATION":
        require(candidates.get("PLANS", {}).get("status") == "READY", "implementation checkpoint requires PLANS READY")
    if lot_id is not None:
        require(checkpoint["phase"] == "IMPLEMENTATION", "lot preflight requires implementation checkpoint")
        require(lot_id in lots, "unknown lot: " + lot_id)
        check_lot(root, lots[lot_id], lots, elements, questions, authorities, manifests["DESIGN"])
    return {"ok": True, "schema": SCHEMA, "phase": checkpoint["phase"], "lot": lot_id,
            "candidate_digests": {scope: m["digest"] for scope, m in manifests.items()}, "observed_drift": observed_drift}


def check_details(lot, elements, questions):
    for key in lot.get("requires_details", []):
        if key in questions:
            require(questions[key]["status"] == "answered", "lot requires unresolved detail: " + key)
        else:
            require(elements[key]["approval"] in ("accepted", "validated"), "lot requires unapproved detail: " + key)


def check_lot(root, lot, lots, elements, questions, authorities, design_manifest):
    check_details(lot, elements, questions)
    for key in lot["prerequisites"]:
        dependency = lot["dependency_kinds"][key]
        proofs(root, dependency.get("evidence"), "available dependency evidence", nonempty=True)
        if dependency["kind"] == "CODE":
            proofs(root, dependency.get("outputs"), "available CODE outputs/API", nonempty=True)
        if dependency["kind"] == "EXECUTION":
            require(lots[key].get("status") == "completed", "EXECUTION prerequisite not completed: " + key)
    pre = lot.get("preconditions")
    require(isinstance(pre, dict), "lot preconditions missing")
    guard = pre.get("railguard")
    require(isinstance(guard, dict) and guard.get("activation") == "active", "lot requires active railguard")
    proof(root, guard.get("ref"), "railguard.ref")
    proofs(root, guard.get("hashes"), "railguard.hashes", nonempty=guard["activation"] == "active")
    auth = pre.get("authorization")
    require(isinstance(auth, dict), "scoped authorization missing")
    granting = authorities.get(auth.get("authority"), {})
    require(granting.get("role") in ("user", "governance", "implementer"), "scoped authorization authority missing")
    require(auth.get("lot_id") == lot["id"], "authorization lot mismatch")
    proof(root, auth.get("source"), "authorization.source")
    allowed = unique_paths(auth.get("paths"), canonical_input=True)
    require(set(lot["paths"]) <= set(allowed), "lot paths exceed authorization")
    if granting["role"] != "user":
        require(lot["id"] in granting["scope"].get("lot_ids", []) and set(allowed) <= set(granting["scope"].get("paths", [])), "authorization exceeds delegated lot/path scope")
    drift = pre.get("drift")
    require(isinstance(drift, dict) and drift.get("classification") in ("none", "expected_previous_lots"), "preflight drift classification missing")
    refs(drift.get("previous_lots"), lots, "drift.previous_lots")
    require(set(drift["previous_lots"]) <= set(lot["prerequisites"]), "drift references non-prerequisite lots")
    if drift["classification"] == "none":
        require(not drift["previous_lots"], "none drift cannot name previous lots")
    else:
        require(drift["previous_lots"], "expected drift requires previous lots")
    proofs(root, drift.get("evidence"), "drift.evidence", nonempty=True)
    proofs(root, pre.get("repository_evidence", []), "repository preconditions evidence")
    check_ledger(root, lot, lots, pre.get("code_state"), design_manifest)


def check_ledger(root, lot, lots, state, design_manifest):
    """Compare scoped raw current bytes against declared baseline + completed outputs."""
    require(isinstance(state, dict), "lot code_state baseline/current/ledger missing")
    current = state.get("current")
    proofs(root, current, "code_state.current")
    require([p["path"] for p in current] == unique_paths([p["path"] for p in current], canonical_input=True), "code current paths must be sorted/unique")
    baseline = state.get("baseline")
    ledger = state.get("ledger")
    require(isinstance(baseline, list) and isinstance(ledger, list), "code baseline/ledger must be arrays")
    expected = {}
    bound_snapshots = {entry["path"]: entry["sha256"] for entry in design_manifest["files"]}
    for entry in baseline:
        require(isinstance(entry, dict), "invalid code baseline")
        path = normalized_path(entry.get("path"))
        require(path == entry["path"] and path not in expected, "duplicate/noncanonical baseline path")
        proof(root, entry.get("snapshot"), "code baseline.snapshot")
        require(bound_snapshots.get(entry["snapshot"]["path"]) == entry["snapshot"]["sha256"], "D0 snapshot must be bound to DESIGN manifest")
        require(entry.get("sha256") == entry["snapshot"]["sha256"], "baseline bytes must equal snapshot bytes")
        identifier(entry.get("revision"), "baseline.revision")
        require(isinstance(entry.get("dirty_hash"), str) and HEX.fullmatch(entry["dirty_hash"]), "baseline dirty_hash missing/invalid")
        expected[path] = entry["sha256"]
    ancestors = set()
    def collect(key):
        for parent in lots[key]["prerequisites"]:
            if parent not in ancestors:
                ancestors.add(parent)
                collect(parent)
    collect(lot["id"])
    prior_seen, last_producer = set(), {}
    for entry in ledger:
        require(isinstance(entry, dict), "invalid ledger entry")
        producer = entry.get("lot_id")
        require(producer in ancestors and lots[producer].get("status") == "completed", "ledger output must belong to completed ancestor lot")
        path = normalized_path(entry.get("path"))
        require(path == entry["path"] and path in lots[producer]["paths"], "ledger output outside producer scope")
        require((producer, path) not in prior_seen, "duplicate ledger output")
        prior_seen.add((producer, path))
        if path in last_producer:
            earlier = last_producer[path]
            producer_ancestors = set()
            def previous(key):
                for parent in lots[key]["prerequisites"]:
                    if parent not in producer_ancestors:
                        producer_ancestors.add(parent)
                        previous(parent)
            previous(producer)
            require(earlier in producer_ancestors, "ledger overlapping outputs must follow dependency order")
        last_producer[path] = producer
        require(isinstance(entry.get("sha256"), str) and HEX.fullmatch(entry["sha256"]), "ledger SHA256 invalid")
        proofs(root, entry.get("evidence"), "ledger.evidence", nonempty=True)
        expected[path] = entry["sha256"]
    require(set(expected) == {p["path"] for p in current}, "code current inventory differs from baseline/ledger")
    for entry in current:
        require(entry["sha256"] == expected[entry["path"]], "unexpected current code drift: " + entry["path"])


def promote_checkpoint(root, pending, current):
    # Validate exactly the bytes being promoted before touching an existing checkpoint.
    pending_bytes = Path(pending).read_bytes()
    value = read_json(pending)
    check_state(root, value)
    require(Path(pending).read_bytes() == pending_bytes, "pending checkpoint changed during validation")
    target = Path(current).resolve()
    base = Path(root).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(base), "current checkpoint must stay within root")
    protected = set()
    def protect_refs(obj):
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            if set(obj) == {"path", "sha256"}:
                protected.add(rooted(root, obj["path"]))
            for child in obj.values():
                protect_refs(child)
        elif isinstance(obj, list):
            for child in obj:
                protect_refs(child)
    protect_refs(value)
    for candidate in value["candidates"].values():
        manifest_path = rooted(root, candidate["manifest"])
        protected.add(manifest_path)
        for entry in verify_manifest(root, manifest_path, check_corpus=candidate["status"] != "STALE")["files"]:
            protected.add(resolved_path(root, entry["path"]))
    require(target not in protected, "current checkpoint would overwrite corpus/manifest/evidence")
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".predev-", suffix=".json", dir=target.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(canonical(value))
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, target)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)
    return {"ok": True, "current": str(target)}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    create = sub.add_parser("create-manifest")
    create.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    create.add_argument("--scope", choices=("DESIGN", "PLANS"), required=True)
    create.add_argument("--candidate-id", required=True)
    create.add_argument("--design-candidate-id")
    create.add_argument("--files-list", required=True, help="path to a JSON array of relative paths")
    create.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    verify = sub.add_parser("verify-manifest")
    verify.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    verify.add_argument("--manifest", required=True)
    check = sub.add_parser("check-state")
    check.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    check.add_argument("--state", required=True)
    check.add_argument("--lot")
    promote = sub.add_parser("promote-checkpoint")
    promote.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    promote.add_argument("--pending", required=True)
    promote.add_argument("--current", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "create-manifest":
            value = create_manifest(args.root, args.scope, args.candidate_id, read_json(args.files_list), args.design_candidate_id)
            target = Path(args.output).resolve()
            require(target.is_relative_to(Path(args.root).resolve()), "manifest output must stay within root")
            require(target not in [rooted(args.root, entry["path"]) for entry in value["files"]], "manifest output cannot overwrite corpus file")
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(canonical(value))
            result = {"ok": True, "digest": value["digest"], "output": str(target)}
        elif args.command == "verify-manifest":
            value = verify_manifest(args.root, args.manifest)
            result = {"ok": True, "scope": value["scope"], "candidate_id": value["candidate_id"], "digest": value["digest"]}
        elif args.command == "check-state":
            result = check_state(args.root, args.state, args.lot)
        else:
            result = promote_checkpoint(args.root, args.pending, args.current)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(canonical(result))
        return 0
    except (ControlError, OSError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("predev-control: " + str(exc) + "\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Persist attributed readOnly proposals in explicitly allowed documentation roots."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import sys
import uuid

# CLI persistence must not leave interpreter cache files in the installed pack.
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import predev_control as pc

SCHEMA = "rust-predev-host/1"
SAFE_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,95}\Z")
DOC_EXTENSIONS = {".md", ".json", ".txt", ".csv", ".tsv"}
FORBIDDEN = {".git", ".codex", "cargo.toml", "cargo.lock", "config.toml", "memory", "memories", "config"}
RESERVED = {"proposal.json", "receipt.json", "manifest.json", "transport-manifest.json"}


def safe_id(value, label):
    pc.require(isinstance(value, str) and SAFE_ID.fullmatch(value), label + " must be a safe immutable version ID")
    pc.require(value.upper() not in {"CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", *("COM" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10)), *("LPT" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10))}, "reserved Windows version ID forbidden")
    return value


def sha_bytes(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _link(path):
    return path.is_symlink() or getattr(path, "is_junction", lambda: False)()


def docs_root(root):
    raw = Path(root).absolute()
    pc.require(raw.is_dir() and not _link(raw), "documentation root must exist and must not be a symlink/junction")
    base = raw.resolve()
    pc.require(base.name.casefold() not in FORBIDDEN, "root is a protected configuration/memory/repository directory")
    repo_docs_root = None
    for ancestor in [base, *base.parents]:
        pc.require(ancestor.name.casefold() not in {"memory", "memories", "config", "configuration", "skills", "agents", "plugins"}, "documentation root must stay outside configuration/memory/pack sources")
        if (ancestor / ".git").exists() or (ancestor / "Cargo.toml").exists():
            repo_docs_root = ancestor
            break
    if repo_docs_root is not None:
        # Permit the shared docs/predev root for compatibility, or one
        # project-specific directory directly below it. The policy still
        # allowlists this exact root and exact document paths.
        docs = repo_docs_root / "docs"
        predev = docs / "predev"
        shared_root = base == predev
        project_root = base.parent == predev and base.name.casefold() not in FORBIDDEN
        pc.require(shared_root or project_root, "repository documentation root must be exactly docs/predev or docs/predev/<project>")
        pc.require((repo_docs_root / ".git").exists(), "repository documentation root must be under a Git repository")
    for path in base.rglob("*"):
        pc.require(not _link(path), "symlink/junction forbidden in documentation root: " + str(path.relative_to(base)))
        pc.require(path.name.casefold() not in FORBIDDEN, "protected entry in documentation root: " + str(path.relative_to(base)))
        if path.is_file():
            pc.require(path.suffix.casefold() in DOC_EXTENSIONS, "non-document file in documentation root: " + str(path.relative_to(base)))
    return base


def doc_path(value):
    path = pc.normalized_path(value)
    pc.require(not any(part.casefold() in FORBIDDEN for part in path.split("/")), "protected path forbidden")
    pc.require(Path(path).suffix.casefold() in DOC_EXTENSIONS, "proposal accepts documentation files only")
    pc.require(not any(char in path for char in '<>"|?*'), "Windows path alias/glob forbidden")
    for part in path.split("/"):
        pc.require(part == part.rstrip(" ."), "trailing dot/space path alias forbidden")
        stem = part.split(".")[0].upper()
        pc.require(stem not in {"CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", *("COM" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10)), *("LPT" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10))}, "reserved Windows path forbidden")
    return path


def _read_snapshot(path):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    value = pc.read_json(path)
    pc.require(Path(path).read_bytes() == raw, "input changed while being read")
    return value, sha_bytes(raw)


def _pack(pack_root, manifest_path):
    manifest = pc.verify_manifest(pack_root, manifest_path)
    for filename in ("predev_host.py", "predev_control.py"):
        matches = [entry for entry in manifest["files"] if Path(entry["path"]).name == filename]
        pc.require(len(matches) == 1, "pack must bind exactly one " + filename)
        runtime = Path(__file__).with_name(filename)
        pc.require(pc.file_hash(runtime) == matches[0]["sha256"], "pack differs from running helper/controller: " + filename)
    return manifest


def _catalogue(root):
    result = {}
    folder = root / "candidates"
    if not folder.exists():
        return result
    pc.require(folder.is_dir(), "candidates must be a directory")
    for directory in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        pc.require(directory.is_dir(), "unexpected candidate entry")
        key = safe_id(directory.name, "stored candidate")
        receipt = pc.read_json(directory / "receipt.json")
        manifest = pc.verify_manifest(root, directory / "manifest.json")
        pc.require(receipt.get("kind") == "HOST_PERSISTED" and receipt.get("scope") in ("DESIGN", "PLANS"), "invalid stored receipt")
        pc.require(receipt.get("target_candidate_id") == key == manifest["candidate_id"] and receipt["scope"] == manifest["scope"], "stored candidate identity mismatch")
        pc.require(type(receipt.get("generation")) is int and receipt["generation"] > 0, "stored generation invalid")
        paths = {entry["path"] for entry in manifest["files"]}
        pc.require({"candidates/" + key + "/receipt.json", "candidates/" + key + "/proposal.json"} <= paths, "stored receipt/proposal must be bound to manifest")
        pc.require(key.casefold() not in {name.casefold() for name in result}, "candidate ID case collision")
        result[key] = {"receipt": receipt, "manifest": manifest}
    for key, item in result.items():
        receipt = item["receipt"]
        parent = receipt["base_candidate_id"]
        if parent is None:
            pc.require(receipt["generation"] == 1, "initial candidate generation mismatch")
        else:
            pc.require(parent in result and result[parent]["receipt"]["scope"] == receipt["scope"], "stored base scope missing/mismatch")
            pc.require(receipt["generation"] == result[parent]["receipt"]["generation"] + 1, "stored candidate generation mismatch")
    for scope in ("DESIGN", "PLANS"):
        generations = [v["receipt"]["generation"] for v in result.values() if v["receipt"]["scope"] == scope]
        pc.require(len(generations) == len(set(generations)), "candidate history fork detected")
    return result


def _transports(root, catalogue):
    folder = root / "transports"
    if not folder.exists():
        return {}
    pc.require(folder.is_dir(), "transports must be a directory")
    result = {}
    for directory in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        pc.require(directory.is_dir(), "unexpected transport entry")
        key = safe_id(directory.name, "transport ID")
        manifest_path = directory / "transport-manifest.json"
        manifest = pc.read_json(manifest_path)
        pc.require(isinstance(manifest, dict) and set(manifest) == {"schema", "transport_id", "base_candidate_id", "files", "digest"}, "invalid transport manifest")
        pc.require(manifest_path.read_bytes() == pc.canonical(manifest), "transport manifest must be canonical")
        pc.require(manifest["schema"] == "rust-predev-transport/1" and manifest["transport_id"] == key and manifest["base_candidate_id"] in catalogue, "transport identity/base mismatch")
        pc.require(manifest["digest"] == pc.payload_digest({k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k != "digest"}), "transport digest mismatch")
        pc.proofs(root, manifest["files"], "transport files", nonempty=True)
        paths = [entry["path"] for entry in manifest["files"]]
        pc.require(paths == pc.unique_paths(paths, canonical_input=True) and all(p.startswith("transports/" + key + "/") for p in paths), "transport corpus outside its immutable version")
        pc.require({"transports/" + key + "/receipt.json", "transports/" + key + "/proposal.json"} <= set(paths), "transport receipt/proposal not bound")
        receipt = pc.read_json(directory / "receipt.json")
        pc.require(receipt.get("target_candidate_id") == key and receipt.get("scope") == "TRANSPORT", "transport receipt mismatch")
        result[key] = receipt
    return result


def _head(catalogue, scope):
    values = [(v["receipt"]["generation"], key) for key, v in catalogue.items() if v["receipt"]["scope"] == scope]
    return max(values)[1] if values else None


def audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest):
    root = docs_root(root)
    proposal, proposal_hash = _read_snapshot(proposal_path)
    policy, policy_hash = _read_snapshot(policy_path)
    pc.require(isinstance(policy, dict) and policy.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "invalid host policy schema")
    pc.identifier(policy.get("host_actor"), "policy.host_actor")
    pc.identifier(policy.get("proposal_actor"), "policy.proposal_actor")
    pc.require(policy["host_actor"] != policy["proposal_actor"], "host and readOnly proposal actors must be distinct")
    roots = policy.get("roots")
    pc.require(isinstance(roots, list) and roots and all(isinstance(p, str) and Path(p).is_absolute() for p in roots), "policy roots must be an explicit absolute allowlist")
    pc.require(root in [Path(p).resolve() for p in roots], "documentation root is not allowlisted")
    allowed = pc.unique_paths(policy.get("paths"), canonical_input=True)
    for path in allowed:
        doc_path(path)
    pc.proof(root, policy.get("source"), "host authorization source")
    pc.require(isinstance(proposal, dict) and proposal.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "invalid host proposal schema")
    scope = proposal.get("scope")
    pc.require(scope in ("DESIGN", "PLANS", "TRANSPORT"), "host proposal scope invalid")
    keys = {"schema", "scope", "proposal_id", "actor", "base_candidate_id", "target_candidate_id", "pack_digest", "files"}
    if scope == "PLANS":
        keys.add("design_candidate_id")
    pc.require(set(proposal) == keys, "proposal fields or scope/parent mismatch")
    safe_id(proposal["proposal_id"], "proposal_id")
    target = safe_id(proposal["target_candidate_id"], "target_candidate_id")
    base = proposal["base_candidate_id"]
    if base is not None:
        safe_id(base, "base_candidate_id")
    pc.require(target != base, "target candidate must be new")
    pc.require(proposal["actor"] == policy["proposal_actor"], "proposal actor not authorized by policy")
    pack = _pack(pack_root, pack_manifest)
    pc.require(proposal["pack_digest"] == pack["digest"], "proposal pack digest stale/mismatch")
    catalogue = _catalogue(root)
    transports = _transports(root, catalogue)
    used = [*catalogue, *transports]
    pc.require(target.casefold() not in {p.casefold() for p in used}, "immutable target already exists or collides")
    receipts = [entry["receipt"] for entry in catalogue.values()] + list(transports.values())
    pc.require(proposal["proposal_id"] not in {r["proposal_id"] for r in receipts}, "proposal_id already persisted")
    if scope == "TRANSPORT":
        pc.require(base in catalogue and base == _head(catalogue, catalogue[base]["receipt"]["scope"]), "transport base candidate missing/stale")
    else:
        pc.require(base == _head(catalogue, scope), "base candidate stale or wrong scope")
    if scope == "PLANS":
        design = safe_id(proposal["design_candidate_id"], "design_candidate_id")
        pc.require(design == _head(catalogue, "DESIGN") and design is not None, "PLANS parent DESIGN missing/stale")
        pc.require(target != design, "PLANS ID must differ from DESIGN parent")
    files = proposal["files"]
    pc.require(isinstance(files, list) and files, "proposal files must be nonempty array")
    contents, normalized = {}, []
    for entry in files:
        pc.require(isinstance(entry, dict) and set(entry) == {"path", "content", "base_sha256"}, "proposal file must be {path,content,base_sha256}")
        path = doc_path(entry["path"])
        normalized.append(path)
        pc.require(path in allowed and path.casefold() not in RESERVED, "proposal path outside exact documentation allowlist or reserved")
        pc.require(isinstance(entry["content"], str), "proposal content must be UTF-8 text")
        content = entry["content"].encode("utf-8")
        expected_base = None
        if base is not None and scope != "TRANSPORT":
            candidate_path = root / "candidates" / base / path
            if candidate_path.exists():
                pc.require(candidate_path.is_file(), "base path must be file")
                expected_base = pc.file_hash(candidate_path)
                corpus_paths = {f["path"] for f in catalogue[base]["manifest"]["files"]}
                pc.require(candidate_path.relative_to(root).as_posix() in corpus_paths, "base file not bound to its manifest")
        pc.require(entry["base_sha256"] == expected_base, "base file SHA256 missing/stale: " + path)
        contents[path] = content
    sorted_paths = pc.unique_paths(normalized, canonical_input=True)
    for path in sorted_paths:
        pc.require(not any(other.casefold().startswith(path.casefold() + "/") for other in sorted_paths if other != path), "file/directory path collision")
    folder = "transports" if scope == "TRANSPORT" else "candidates"
    destination = root / folder / target
    pc.require(not destination.exists(), "immutable destination already exists")
    generation = 1 if base is None or scope == "TRANSPORT" else catalogue[base]["receipt"]["generation"] + 1
    return {"ok": True, "mode": "AUDIT", "root": str(root), "destination": str(destination),
            "proposal": proposal, "proposal_sha256": proposal_hash, "policy_sha256": policy_hash,
            "generation": generation, "pack_digest": pack["digest"], "host_actor": policy["host_actor"],
            "authority_source": policy["source"], "files": [{"path": p, "sha256": sha_bytes(contents[p])} for p in sorted_paths]}


def _write(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def apply(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest):
    checked = audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest)
    root = Path(checked["root"])
    lock = root / ".predev-host-lock"
    try:
        lock.mkdir()
    except FileExistsError as exc:
        raise pc.ControlError("another host writer is active; inspect existing lock without deleting it automatically") from exc
    try:
        pc.require(audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest) == checked, "inputs changed while acquiring host lock")
        return _apply_checked(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest, checked)
    finally:
        lock.rmdir()


def _apply_checked(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest, checked):
    proposal = checked["proposal"]
    # Windows Python 3.13 treats 0700 as a private ACL; inherit the already
    # authorized documentation-root ACL instead of publishing private temp ACLs.
    stage = root / (".predev-stage-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    stage.mkdir(mode=0o777, exist_ok=False)
    destination = Path(checked["destination"])
    parent_created = False
    try:
        for entry in proposal["files"]:
            _write(stage / doc_path(entry["path"]), entry["content"].encode("utf-8"))
        receipt = {"schema": SCHEMA, "kind": "HOST_PERSISTED", "scope": proposal["scope"],
                   "proposal_id": proposal["proposal_id"], "actor": proposal["actor"], "persisted_by": checked["host_actor"],
                   "base_candidate_id": proposal["base_candidate_id"], "target_candidate_id": proposal["target_candidate_id"],
                   "generation": checked["generation"], "proposal_sha256": checked["proposal_sha256"],
                   "policy_sha256": checked["policy_sha256"], "pack_digest": checked["pack_digest"],
                   "authority_source": checked["authority_source"], "files": checked["files"]}
        if proposal["scope"] == "PLANS":
            receipt["design_candidate_id"] = proposal["design_candidate_id"]
        _write(stage / "proposal.json", pc.canonical(proposal))
        _write(stage / "receipt.json", pc.canonical(receipt))
        local_paths = [entry["path"] for entry in checked["files"]] + ["proposal.json", "receipt.json"]
        prefix = destination.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        corpus = [{"path": prefix + "/" + p, "sha256": pc.file_hash(stage / p)} for p in local_paths]
        if proposal["scope"] == "TRANSPORT":
            payload = {"schema": "rust-predev-transport/1", "transport_id": proposal["target_candidate_id"],
                       "base_candidate_id": proposal["base_candidate_id"], "files": sorted(corpus, key=lambda p: p["path"])}
            manifest = dict(payload, digest=pc.payload_digest(payload))
            manifest_name = "transport-manifest.json"
        else:
            # Use controller to hash the actual staged corpus, then map to final immutable paths.
            manifest = pc.create_manifest(stage, proposal["scope"], proposal["target_candidate_id"], local_paths,
                                          proposal.get("design_candidate_id"))
            manifest["files"] = corpus
            if proposal["scope"] == "PLANS":
                parent = "candidates/" + proposal["design_candidate_id"] + "/manifest.json"
                manifest["files"].append({"path": parent, "sha256": pc.file_hash(pc.rooted(root, parent))})
            manifest["files"].sort(key=lambda p: p["path"])
            manifest["digest"] = pc.payload_digest({k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k != "digest"})
            manifest_name = "manifest.json"
        _write(stage / manifest_name, pc.canonical(manifest))
        rechecked = audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest)
        pc.require(rechecked == checked, "proposal/policy/source/base/pack changed before promotion")
        if not destination.parent.exists():
            destination.parent.mkdir()
            parent_created = True
        pc.require(not destination.exists(), "immutable target appeared during promotion")
        os.rename(stage, destination)
        return {"ok": True, "mode": "HOST_PERSISTED", "scope": proposal["scope"],
                "destination": str(destination), "receipt": str(destination / "receipt.json"),
                "manifest_digest": manifest["digest"], "files": checked["files"],
                "actor": proposal["actor"], "persisted_by": checked["host_actor"]}
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            pc.require(stage.parent == root and stage.name.startswith(".predev-stage-") and not _link(stage), "unsafe staging cleanup refused")
            shutil.rmtree(stage)
        if parent_created and destination.parent.exists() and not any(destination.parent.iterdir()):
            destination.parent.rmdir()


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ("audit", "apply"):
        item = sub.add_parser(name)
        for option in ("root", "proposal", "policy", "pack-root", "pack-manifest"):
            item.add_argument("--" + option, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        function = audit if args.command == "audit" else apply
        result = function(args.root, args.proposal, args.policy, args.pack_root, args.pack_manifest)
        if args.command == "audit":
            result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "proposal"}
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(pc.canonical(result))
        return 0
    except (pc.ControlError, OSError, UnicodeError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("predev-host: " + str(exc) + "\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare an exported UTF-8 source with a TRANSPORT proposal and saved raw file."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import predev_control as pc


def verify(source_path, proposal_path=None, transport_path=None, proposal_file=None):
    pc.require(proposal_path is not None or transport_path is not None,
               "proposal or transport is required")
    source = Path(source_path).read_bytes()
    source.decode("utf-8")
    result = {"ok": True, "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
              "source_bytes": len(source)}
    if proposal_path is not None:
        proposal = pc.read_json(proposal_path)
        pc.require(isinstance(proposal, dict) and proposal.get("scope") == "TRANSPORT",
                   "proposal must have TRANSPORT scope")
        files = proposal.get("files")
        pc.require(isinstance(files, list), "proposal files must be an array")
        matches = [entry for entry in files if isinstance(entry, dict) and
